name: Star number of Tagged Singletons
details: With $n$ ordinary coordinates, as in the database definition of tagged singletons.
proof: Project to all $n$ ordinary coordinates.  The empty concept gives the star centre, and each tagged singleton $\{i,n+f(i)\}$ restricts to the leaf $\{i\}$, producing an $n$-star.  Conversely, in a star witness each selected tag coordinate either contributes its tag singleton as a leaf or prevents every ordinary coordinate carrying that tag from being a one-coordinate leaf.  Taking all ordinary coordinates is optimal, so no star has more than $n$ leaves.
